title: Arthur Cayley: Collected Mathematical Papers, Draft/Provenance LaTeX Readers and Repair Packets
version: 2026-06-25 strengthened accuracy caveat for draft/provenance Cayley material
description:
Dedicated Arthur Cayley author record for draft/provenance LaTeX readers, repair packets, diagram/table salvage material, TeX sources, and continuation manifests. The current Cayley PDFs and TeX are retained for inspection, repair, and source comparison, but they are not accuracy-certified, not a critical edition, and should not be cited as faithful transcriptions without checking the source scans. Source comparison found substantial symbol/text mismatches in Volume I material, including rendered ranges that looked superficially usable.

Status warning. Inherited Cayley filenames containing terms such as Complete, Source-Checked, or critical are obsolete package labels rather than current quality claims. No Cayley range is presently promoted as source-faithful until a later page-by-page glyph/source audit re-promotes that exact range. Existing files remain useful as provenance, salvage, repair-support, and source-comparison material.

Status at a glance. Source-faithful public certification: no currently promoted range. Represented TeX/PDF coverage: broad rendered readers and chunks exist, but they are suspect until checked against the source. Provenance and repair support: source TeX chunks, repair packets, audit notes, scan-derived diagram/table work, and the GitHub mirror are preserved, while large raw provenance remains on the main preservation record. OCR, math-OCR, crop, and candidate-TeX outputs are witness layers rather than source authority.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Dedicated Cayley author DOI. Current Cayley volume readers, TeX, unit indexes, and ZIPs are retained as draft/provenance and repair material, not as accuracy-certified transcriptions and not a critical edition. Do not treat Complete, Source-Checked, or critical filenames as current quality claims; no Cayley range is presently promoted as source-faithful until a later page-by-page glyph/source audit re-promotes that exact range.
